items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs DAL after ETR EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring return). Rapoport confirmed up with other Eagles activations.
items.why: Hamstring recovery; practiced and cleared for return.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role; reverse any Pierce or committee beneficiaries.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend injury summary; missed another game with ankle injury. Rapoport noted he was close but held out, expected back next week.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited practice but downgraded.
items.implication: Huntley starts again; Ravens pass catchers and Henry/Likely usage shifts without dual-threat QB.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and Ravens skill players adjusted roles

items.text: Puka Nacua was GTD/OPTIMISM then officially ACTIVE despite calf injury. Schefter and Rapoport confirmed active vs Raiders.
items.why: Calf issue from practice but cleared; Rams confident.
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected; reverse any Mumpfield or secondary beneficiary plays.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then inactive (quad); Rapoport said unlikely pregame, Schefter listed among inactives. Fourth straight miss.
items.why: Quad strain; limited practice only, not full participant.
items.implication: Braelon Allen full lead role again (RB1/2 upside vs MIA); Hall likely Week 8.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%. Dobbins only 21% snaps; Harvey fluky TD.
items.why: Clear snap/rush/route lead on return; Dobbins marginalized.
items.implication: Coleman primary; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded in committee.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR PPG via 9 carries inside 5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume in RZ and targets offsets poor per-play efficiency; backup better YPC in same scheme.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2 via opportunity even if rushing efficiency stays low; hold/start.
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics conflict with volume-driven production

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (with Dontayvion Wicks) in ETR summary for Eagles MNF. Creates slot/TE opportunity.
items.implication: Elevated targets for Goedert, remaining WRs, and slot options vs DAL.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets redistribution in Eagles passing game

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT alongside DeVonta Smith per ETR. Further thins Eagles WR room for MNF.
items.implication: More volume to remaining pass-catchers; Berry highlighted slot bet on Lemon.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and BACK; Berry discussing ROS fantasy value after return.
items.why: Cleared and returned to Packers backfield.
items.implication: Reclaims lead RB role; monitor split but strong ROS RB2/1 potential.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; Berry advises sell-high if possible on the big game.
items.why: Outlier explosion; sell into peak value.
items.implication: Trade asset now; sustainability questionable ROS.
items.conflict: Recent production vs longer-term role/efficiency concerns

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024; others mid.
items.why: Dominant route share post-Dell return; Dell limited.
items.implication: Nico locked as WR1; Dell not immediate threat to volume.

items.text: Chiefs WR routes without Rice (2nd game): Xavier Worthy 33 of 36 Mahomes dropbacks (near every). Note: never topped 83 rec yards in 37 career games.
items.why: Massive route rate in Rice absence; ceiling historically limited.
items.implication: High floor volume but efficiency/ceiling caution for boom weeks.
items.conflict: High usage vs historical low ceiling

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain on severity; listed in ETR Sunday watch with Tracy.
items.why: Hamstring; Levitan believes real but uncertain extent.
items.implication: Monitor for role reduction; Tracy also hamstring opens possible committee or backup path.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; Levitan high confidence no real issue.
items.implication: No downgrade; continues elite RB1 role.
